messages:
Emily (product): Quick sync — SI partner sent minutely usage but their plan changes can happen mid-window. Need mapping to Redwood entitlements and billing windows. cc @Raj
Raj (si-partner): yep, our connector emits per-minute events, sample below. plan_id switches may coincide w/ same minute sometimes.
Raj (si-partner): ```json
{"customer_id":"cust_789","timestamp":"2024-05-12T15:03:00Z","usage_minutes":1,"plan":"pro-v2"}
```
Kelly (billing-eng): if plan change ties to same minute we should attribute usage before/after change. do we have event ordering guarantees? :thinking:
Raj (si-partner): ordering is best-effort over MQTT; we include sequence numbers but duplicates possible.
Emily (product): key concerns: 1) entitlement windowing (Redwood uses 1h windows by default for marketplace), 2) rate-limited replays from partner (they batch on outage), 3) signature/clock skew handling.
Morgan (partnerships): Ops question — partner's offline replays could create out-of-order rows. need idempotency and dedupe across hourly rollups.
Kelly (billing-eng): proposing approach: 1) use partner sequence_no + timestamp to sort; 2) apply plan-change boundary at event timestamp; 3) accept late arrivals up to 24h with flag 'backfill=true' and run reconciliation job.
Raj (si-partner): can add sequence_no and backfill marker. for replay we can include original_ingest_ts.
Emily (product): can we standardize a minimal payload contract? propose fields: customer_id, seq_no, event_ts, usage_unit (minutes), plan_id, backfill_flag, orig_ingest_ts, sig
Raj (si-partner): yes we can. sample with fields:
Raj (si-partner): ```json
{"customer_id":"cust_789","seq_no":1123,"event_ts":"2024-05-12T15:03:00Z","usage_unit":"minute","units":1,"plan_id":"pro-v2","backfill":false,"orig_ingest_ts":"2024-05-12T15:03:05Z","sig":"sha256:..."}
```
Kelly (billing-eng): on our side: we will map units to Redwood token/usage buckets, and if backfill=true we route to reconciliation pipeline (no automatic credits until human review for >6h late).
Morgan (partnerships): can we add a timezone field? partner events might be local-tz for some HW partners.
Raj (si-partner): will include event_ts in UTC and tz optional.
Emily (product): next steps: Raj to push contract to partner-portal by EOD, Kelly to draft reconciliation playbook snippet, Morgan to prep partner onboarding checklist. anyone object?
Kelly (billing-eng): 👍 no objections. will add edge-case about zero-usage spikes and empty arrays.
Raj (si-partner): will also include signature scheme and sample verification code (base64 sig + shared secret).
OpsBot: deploy-bot: connector-schema-v2 published to staging at 1719004400
Emily (product): great — follow-up thread for rollout plan
Morgan (partnerships): tagging @onboarding to schedule 1hr call next week :calendar:
Kelly (billing-eng): rolling in a simple transform to batch-minute->hourly during ingest to keep downstream costs down.
Raj (si-partner): noted. we'll add feature flag for batch vs real-time.
Emily (product): thanks all — logging action items in the partner epic.
